author: Player3
content:
Stage 33: close semi_latus_squarefree and semi_latus_distinct_omega_2
Both reduce to elementary factorization facts about the QA generators
a=b+2e and b, via rad(a*b)=rad(a) union rad(b):
- semi_latus_squarefree iff a,b squarefree and gcd(a,b)=1
- semi_latus_distinct_omega_2 iff |primes(a) union primes(b)|=2

Verified over 160,000 (b,e) pairs, zero mismatches; support counts
(45,648 and 16,114) match the Stage 27 triage exactly. This closes the
last two REDUCIBLE_TO_COMPONENT_FACTORIZATION targets from that triage
(the third, ecc_den_smooth_13, was already reduced there). Strength
class: elementary structural reduction, not conic parametrization.

content:
Add QA Orbit Satellite Ramification Cert [533]; fix qa_orbit_rules.py docstring; close [291]'s 5
m gap|Derives why orbit_family's period-8 satellite class exists and why the
divisor shortcut under-counts by exactly 32 whenever 5|m: qa_step is
conjugate to the Fibonacci matrix mod m, whose characteristic polynomial
x^2-x-1 (discriminant 5) is irreducible mod 3 (period-8 source) and
ramified mod 5 (repeated root, giving a 4-vector period-4 eigenspace).
CRT/lcm composition of the two produces exactly 8x4=32 shortcut-missed
satellites. Replaces qa_orbit_rules.py's hand-wave ("Pisano-period
structure") with the derivation, verified for m in {9,15,24,30,45,60,75}.

The same mod-5 argument closes an explicitly flagged open item in the
existing cert [291] (QA Fibonacci Matrix Orbit Periods): whether the
Satellite class is provably empty for m=10,20, previously confirmed only
by enumeration. Cross-referenced in both directions.

Also folds in two pre-existing [291] fixture files that were already
relied on by its passing self-test but had never been committed.
